# David Dimalanta — Portfolio

> Toronto-based Product Designer. Available for full-time roles.

## About

David Dimalanta is a product designer based in Toronto, Canada, with a background in interaction design, UI/UX, and frontend development. He studies at the University of Toronto. His work blends a strong foundation in math and code with a focus on clear, human-centred product experiences.

- Email: david.dimalanta@mail.utoronto.ca
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/daviddimalanta/
- GitHub: https://github.com/davidjamesdimalanta
- CV: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1LcdDAdHLevMjm8qTPHausg9N1TRkvDBZ/view

## Case Studies

### Goable — Unearthing Hidden Barriers in Accessible Washrooms
URL: https://daviddim.ca/project/goable
A research-driven project uncovering accessibility gaps in public washroom design through user interviews, field observation, and iterative prototyping.

### Socratic — Tailor Your Scholarship Essays with Critical Thinkers
URL: https://daviddim.ca/project/socratic
An AI-assisted writing tool that helps students craft stronger scholarship essays by engaging with Socratic dialogue and critical thinking frameworks.

### iHub — Web Developer of a Campus Design Agency
URL: https://daviddim.ca/project/ihub
Frontend development and design work for iHub, a student-run design agency at the University of Toronto.
